x-healthchecks.description: The checks of one Healthchecks.io project, and the service each watches.

triggers.budget: Healthchecks.io asks for at most 100 API requests a minute (its API docs). A run makes two GET calls to /api/v3/checks/, one in discover and one in fetch, whatever the number of checks
triggers.cadence_rationale: Checks, their tags and the services they watch change when someone edits the project, a few times a week; hourly keeps the graph current at two calls an hour.
